purpose: Planetary science as comparative study of solar-system worlds through missions, remote sensing, samples, geology, chemistry, and models.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name world, site, mission, instrument, date, and spatial coverage. Separate local conditions, inferred history, habitability, and evidence of life.
